channel.title: Tim Reska, blog
channel.description: Two news radars, one on AI coding tools and one on nanopore sequencing and metagenomics, plus occasional longer posts.

item.title: How an out-of-memory abort let a single request run code on PHP servers
item.description: Two critical flaws in the PHP interpreter allow unauthenticated remote code execution on web servers. PHP fixed them on 21 October 2026 by removing the jump-based out-of-memory abort and resetting request-owned state; a third, unpatched flaw followed on 23 October.

item.title: Rapid metagenomics changed antimicrobial treatment for 26% of pediatric intensive care samples
item.description: Rapid clinical metagenomics altered antimicrobial treatment for 26% of samples in a pediatric intensive care unit, wastewater resistance signals were shown to depend on the bacterial host, and no new nanopore software was released. Covers 25 September to 16 October 2026.

item.title: A third of coding-agent runs graded as correct violate the task, an audit finds
item.description: Four models were released within three weeks, several model retirements affect configurations that pin a model name, and an audit indicates that coding-agent benchmark scores are inflated by about a third. Covers 25 September to 16 October 2026.
